name: Carousel
access: OML creates this object from a selector:Carousel node. Reach the instance with find or cfind, then call methods on that instance. Method names are not OML keys.

properties.name: views
properties.description: Panels. The wiki types this as required. OML can use node:OML or list plus display instead. Optional.

properties.name: drag
properties.description: The user can swipe between panels. Defaults to true. Optional.

properties.name: drag_left
properties.description: The user can swipe left. Defaults to true. Optional.

properties.name: drag_right
properties.description: The user can swipe right. Defaults to true. Optional.

properties.name: blur
properties.description: Blur views that are not displayed. Defaults to true. Optional.

properties.name: list
properties.description: Items converted to OML nodes. Added in 1.23.0. Optional.

properties.name: display
properties.description: Display used to convert list into nodes. Optional.

properties.name: displays
properties.description: Dynamic displays used to convert list into nodes. Optional.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Shows the panel at that position. The wiki names the extra arguments anim, trigger, and force.

catalog_status: Listed fields and methods are from the OGX.JS wiki or the runtime the test app loads. Members that are absent from this file are not to be invented.
